coordinatedFinding: R7-SN-01 is owned by the resolved-inputs lane; this contract consumes its live PROJECT-ID-V1 owner.
contractDisposition: REPAIRED-WITH-BINDING-CHANGES; NOT YET CLOSED BY REREVIEW
decision: One authority-selection record names the active admitted root for PROJECT-ID-V1. Canonical per-project paths are lexical design guarantees. Physical non-aliasing is a separate product property requiring retained real-file observations. Full-project purge and cross-root migration use exact journal/quarantine/authority state machines with deterministic crash reconciliation.

lexicalLayout.guarantee: Different canonical ProjectIds produce different path strings; fixtures make no claim about file identity.

requiredObservations: regular file type at publish and reuse
different stable file identities for equal digest across ProjectIds
link count one after publish and reuse
no hardlink/reflink/clone/shared-lower-CAS primitive in traced host operations

fullProjectPurge.commitPoint: VERIFIED_ABSENT after canonical and quarantine paths are both absent and root inventory reconciles
fullProjectPurge.ambiguityRule: Malformed/multiple/mismatched journals or moving markers refuse; they never recreate/open a namespace by guess.

crossRootMigration.switch: generation-checked atomic replace on one user-state filesystem after target inventory/objects and physical controls verify
crossRootMigration.beforeSwitch: source remains authoritative and untouched; target rollback allowed
crossRootMigration.afterSwitch: target is authoritative; source retirement recovers forward only

properties: PROJECT-ID-V1 live owner and C-2 wire join
canonical path derivation without claiming physical evidence
single authority CAS, rollback boundary and forward recovery

assurance.why: Contract vectors and mutation tests make the design load-bearing but are not filesystem execution evidence or a deletion/migration demonstration.

scopeLimits: The tool cannot promise control over filesystem/OS block dedup below distinct regular-file identities.
External backup, sync, journals, swap and user-created copies remain outside the deletion protection domain.
The user-state authority registry stores bounded control metadata only and is not a competing evidence backend.
result: The reviewer7 durable-QUARANTINED residual now has an exact recovery transition, fixture and reachable-state coverage control. Do not mark it CLOSED/SEALED until independent replay and coordinator integration.
